prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone, but **Dunn Orthodontics** is a strong Phoenix option to put on your shortlist: its orthodontists, Drs. Courtney and Matthew Dunn, are listed as **board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics**, and the practice offers both braces and Invisalign at several Phoenix-area locations.

Another option is **Serrano Orthodontics**, which also advertises board-certified orthodontists and offers braces and Invisalign at its Phoenix office.

Before choosing, book consultations with two or three practices and compare the proposed treatment plan, total cost and insurance coverage, who will supervise your care, and how follow-up visits are handled. Invisalign isn’t the right fit for every case, so ask whether the orthodontist recommends it for *your* bite and what the alternative would be. You can verify orthodontist credentials through the [American Association of Orthodontists’ locator](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/).
